projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Selected projects completed during my studies or independently.

gestion-medicale.title: Medical Management
gestion-medicale.context: Developed as part of a university team project (L2) aimed at designing a robust desktop application with layered architecture, transaction management, and data persistence.
gestion-medicale.description: Desktop application developed for comprehensive medical practice management. It centralizes patient records, doctor schedules, a 7-step appointment wizard, consultation and prescription tracking, as well as a billing module with PostgreSQL transaction management.
features: Unified management of patients, doctors, and medical records
7-step appointment booking wizard (anti-double booking)
Tracking of consultations, diagnoses, and prescription issuance
Flexible payment module (down payments, balances, and invoicing)
Secure architecture with SQL transactions and persistence via Dapper

gestion-financiere.title: Financial Management
gestion-financiere.context: Developed at the request of a user seeking a tool for household financial management, complete with daily flow tracking and analytical charts to adjust spending habits.
gestion-financiere.description: Personal financial management desktop application. It allows users to track cash flow, organize transactions through a hierarchy of categories, analyze monthly/annual trends, and natively interact with Excel and PDF files.
features: Unified tracking of income and expenses with modification history
Hierarchical categorization of transactions by categories and subcategories
Statistical analysis of financial evolution by month and year
Data import and export in Excel format (ClosedXML)
Generation of professional financial reports in PDF format (QuestPDF)
Secure and autonomous local storage via SQLite database

gestion-session-cepe.title: CEPE Session Management
gestion-session-cepe.meta: Academic Project — Java / JavaFX / Maven — PostgreSQL
gestion-session-cepe.description: Application for managing candidate registration and session organization for an official school examination.

gestion-enseignants.title: Teacher Management
gestion-enseignants.stack: Vue.js 3 + Vite + PHP + PDO + PostgreSQL + Chart.js
gestion-enseignants.context: Developed as part of a university SPA project aiming to design a modern web application with a decoupled frontend/backend architecture, complete with full authentication and dynamic calculations.
gestion-enseignants.description: Single Page Application (SPA) for administrative management of teachers. It centralizes profile details, automatically calculates pay based on hourly rates and worked hours, and visualizes data through interactive statistical charts.
features: Secure authentication with bcrypt hashing, session management, and admin approval
Summary dashboard featuring key performance indicators and overall metrics
Add/edit form with dynamic live previews of pay calculations
Full teacher profile management (multi-criteria search, data tables, deletion confirmations)
Report and analytics module with integrated charts via Chart.js and vue-chartjs
Decoupled architecture between a Vue.js frontend and a PHP/PDO backend API connected to PostgreSQL

gestion-soutenances.title: Thesis Defense Management
gestion-soutenances.context: Created for a practical exam and academic evaluation, designed to build a complete web application with Laravel that fulfills a real-world administrative management need.
gestion-soutenances.description: MVC web application for academic management designed to centralize student, faculty, host organization, and evaluation board records. It automates defense scheduling and official PDF report generation.
features: Centralization of student, teacher, and host organization profiles
Defense scheduling with board assignment, grading, and academic year tracking
Automated official report (PV) generation via FPDF
Replaces fragmented manual tracking with a unified, traceable web interface
Classic MVC architecture on Laravel with database migrations and relational ORM
